**Skill:** `plugins/<topic>/skills/<name>/`

**What it makes, in one line:**

**Reads:** (the skills whose output it needs)

**Writes:** (in `<proposal folder>/<name>/`)

**Tested on:** `competition/proposals/test/`: yes / no

**What still isn't right:**

- [ ] I changed only my own skill folder
- [ ] No key, no personal path, no site, competition or layer name of my own in the skill

- [ ] Drawing skills: no colours, line weights or fonts of my own, and no fixed scale
- [ ] Tested once without the skill too
